nameOrigin: Spanish for 'Miss', referring to a woman

pokedexEntries.bk: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

pokedexEntries.wh: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: According to many old tales, it creates friends for itself by controlling sleeping children on starry nights.

pokedexEntries.as: According to many old tales, it creates friends for itself by controlling sleeping children on starry nights.

pokedexEntries.sw: It’s said that when stars shine in the night sky, this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children. Some call it the Witch of Punishment.

pokedexEntries.sh: On nights when the stars shine, this Pokémon’s psychic power is at its strongest. It’s unknown just what link Gothorita has to the greater universe.

pokedexEntries.sc: This Pokémon will hypnotize children to put them to sleep before carrying them away. Be wary of nights when the starlight is bright.

pokedexEntries.vi: Using its psychic power, it arranges pebbles to form the shapes of constellations. Some people believe this Pokémon came from outer space.
